summary: FactionWorld builds from a scenario document at runtime; the hard-coded island and its include_str! tuning leave the simulation

coordination.notes: Contract: docs/SCENARIO_PACKS.md. Builds to the manifest shape that scenario-pack-tooling bundles; until that lane's generated file exists this lane assembles the same document in a test helper from the current files so the equality proof can run. island_scene.gd changes are limited to how create_island is called and where the land polygon is read from.
